NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
1140-44 SOUTH CALIFORNIA AVENUE

Proposed Zoning: C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial District. The Application is for a Type
One (1) Map Amendment so that the Applicant may construct Non-Accessoty Parking to serve Great
Expectations Learning Academy Incorporated, specifically a nineteen (19) space Non-Accessory
Surface Parking lot.

The footprint of the parking lot shall approximately be 50 feet by 125.52 feet in size.

A. LOT AREA: 6276 square feet

B. FLOOR AREA RATIO: N/A

C. BUILDING AREA: N/A

D. DENSITY per DWELLING UNIT: N/A

E. F-S' ET PARKING: Nineteen (19) parking spaces.

F. FRO SET! K: 5 feet

G. REAR SETBACK: 0 feet

H. SIDE SETBACKS: 0 feet west side yard, 0 feet east side yard
I. BUILDING HEIGHT: N/A

#% ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENT FOR PARKING

The project is located within 100 feet of the entrance to Great Expectations Leaning
Academy.

1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0603-B;

2. The 1100 block of South California Avenue is not designated as a Pedestrian Street.
Therefore, the standards of Section 17-3-0504 are not applicable for this Project;

3. Applicant will scek an Administrative Adjustment under Section 17-13-1003-FF for
the increase from 0 off-strect parking spaces to 19 spaces.

4. Under 17-10-0603-A (1)(a) the non-Accessory Parking is located within 100 feet of
the Use and under (1)(b) is not located in an R or DR District.
